qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dense industrial crane service network generates stable 20%+ EBITA margins, but group returns are heavily diluted by cyclical crane equipment manufacturing and lumpy, competitive port container handling contracts.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12% across cycle, REJECT). While its crane maintenance service agreement base is highly profitable, the majority of revenue derives from cyclical industrial cranes and lumpy port solutions where multi-cycle GAAP ROIC averaged 6-10% (troughing at 7.3% in 2022).
qualitative.evidence: Konecranes' long-term multi-cycle ROIC averaged 6-10% between 2016-2022 prior to the recent post-2023 supply chain backlog surge. Low-margin Port Solutions contracts, exposure to global freight trade volatility, and Asian competitors (e.g. ZPMC) dilute pricing power and group returns below the 12% Munger bar.
